data.command: cargo build --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --bin adashi-mcp; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $exe = Join-Path (Get-Location) 'src-tauri\target\debug\adashi-mcp.exe'; $psi = [System.Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo]::new($exe); $psi.WorkingDirectory = (Get-Location).Path; $psi.UseShellExecute = $false; $psi.RedirectStandardInput = $true; $psi.RedirectStandardOutput = $true; $psi.RedirectStandardError = $true; $p = [System.Diagnostics.Process]::Start($psi); $p.StandardInput.AutoFlush = $true; $p.StandardInput.WriteLine('{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2024-11-05","capabilities":{},"clientInfo":{"name":"adashi-qa","version":"1"}}}'); Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; if (!$p.HasExited) { $p.Kill() }; $out = $p.StandardOutput.ReadToEnd(); $err = $p.StandardError.ReadToEnd(); if ($out -notmatch 'protocolVersion' -or $out -notmatch '"tools"') { Write-Output $out; Write-Error ("MCP initialize smoke failed. stderr: " + $err); exit 1 }; Write-Output 'MCP stdio initialize smoke passed';
data.description: Builds the debug MCP binary, starts it over stdio, sends an MCP initialize request, and asserts that the server returns protocol and tool capability metadata.
data.name: MCP stdio initialize smoke
